content: Bepaŋ’walaŋ titiŋŋiŋ adi momooŋ hinek doktiŋa niutumbanim
Yahwe adi momooŋ hinek doktiŋa welemomooŋ nadimiŋa niutumbanim. Adi weleŋdi hinek dapmandapmaŋnit mokit nibukahilegukdi nibukahilelak.
Yahwedi memik heki’walaŋ kohohik gineniŋ hehikibidali hanagikuk. Wendoktiŋa metam hogohogok indi wanakaŋ Wapum wou nintilonim.
Adi Judahi niŋkade wooŋ hatigiŋ, mele labulabuneŋkade eŋ mele fofoŋneŋkade be kwet wahiŋkade eŋ kwet kumaŋkade, hidi wanaŋ hanagikuk.
Kaŋ noliyeŋ kwet fiileŋ yokwet wapum wooŋ kahileeŋ iitdok talik lohigiŋ,
tiŋa undugoŋ nanaŋe eŋ ime map tiŋa agaŋ kadakanim yoŋa nadibedi tigiŋ,
adi malabumuŋ gineŋ unduŋ hatiŋila Yahwe kutnimbulabulayeune ne kubugoŋdi nadiyemiŋa momooŋ hinek yehitubu-lodaguk.
Tiŋa adigoŋ talik yenindidimeeŋ yanagila wooŋ yokwet wapum niŋ gineŋ yapmeune itowiiŋ.
Wapum adi weleŋdi hinek yabukahilegukdi yabukahilelak doktiŋa titiŋ momooŋ hinek tiŋa helemahelemaŋ yehitubu-lodalak. Unduŋ doktiŋa adi Yahwe kedem welemomooŋ nadimiŋa niutumbayaneŋ.
Metam ime map tiiŋ adi ime tuwot hinek yembune nahaikaiŋ, eŋ metam nanaŋe map tiiŋ adi nanaŋe tuwot hinek yembune natoki tiiŋ.
Kaŋ metam noli adi Bepaŋ, Saŋiniŋ Molom loloŋnit, sigilulum timiŋa medeŋiŋ mu takaligiŋ wendoktiŋa yot fafaŋeniŋ mambip wapumnit gineŋ tawa fafaŋeniŋdi yehitehiune halune malabumuŋ yemgiŋ.
Adi folofigita kwanai gibitaŋ tiŋa gweheyeeŋ maaŋ kwetfoloŋ gwaŋ halune me yehitubu-lodadok nebek nemoŋ.
Adi malabumuŋ gineŋ unduŋ hatiŋila Yahwe kutnimbulabulayeune ne kubugoŋdi nadiyemiŋa momooŋ hinek yehitubu-lodaguk.
Wapum ne kubugoŋdi unduŋ tiyemiŋa tawa fafaŋeniŋ u dobukuyemguk, tiŋa yot fafaŋeniŋ mambip wapumnit gineniŋ yanagikuk.
Wapum adi weleŋdi hinek yabukahilegukdi yabukahilelak doktiŋa titiŋ momooŋ hinek tiŋa helemahelemaŋ yehitubu-lodalak. Unduŋ doktiŋa adi Yahwe kedem welemomooŋ nadimiŋa niutumbayaneŋ.
Tiŋa undugoŋ yot fafaŋeniŋ diniŋ yeme fafaŋehi, momohi hinek tutumbagiŋ u ubulaginekutak, eŋ yeme sumuhep aindi tiiŋ u wobugolokutak.
Metam noli kadakaniŋ tigiŋ doktiŋa yagit tubumintagiŋ. Eŋ titiŋ hogohi wendogoŋ tiŋa malabumuŋ mintayemguk.
Kaŋ nanaŋe tuwot mu naaŋ agaŋ kumuŋdok muniniŋ tigiŋ.
Adi malabumuŋ gineŋ unduŋ hatiŋila Yahwe kutnimbulabulayeune ne kubugoŋdi nadiyemiŋa momooŋ hinek yehitubu-lodaguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa medeŋiŋ kameune wooŋ yehitubu-kedebaguk. Tiŋa kumuŋdok tigiŋ gineniŋ kotigoŋ yehitutumbaaŋ yanagikuk.
Wapum adi weleŋdi hinek yabukahilegukdi yabukahilelak doktiŋa titiŋ momooŋ hinek tiŋa helemahelemaŋ yehitubu-lodalak. Unduŋ doktiŋa adi Yahwe kedem welemomooŋ nadimiŋa niutumbayaneeŋ.
Tiŋa undugoŋ dumuŋ hemiŋa niutumbayaneeŋ. Tiŋa kap toŋa metam hogohogok Wapumdi titiŋ momooŋ tiyemguk u yohautayaneeŋ.
Me noli muneeŋhik kwanai muwage wapuhi foloŋ yauŋa tagiŋ. Adi metam’walaŋ bomboŋhik beŋa boiyemyawagiŋ.
Adi Yahwedi kudi wapuhi fee tubune kagiŋ. Kudi u uŋgoniŋ hinek imeŋgwaŋ foloŋ tubune kagiŋ.
Wapumdi yobune sububa saŋiniŋnit hinek wendi ime fedigiyondaaŋ beŋa foloniŋgoŋ kula uguk.

Unduŋ tiŋa muwage heki u imedi yanagi beŋa foloniŋgoŋ looŋ kotigoŋ biyabune fowooŋ ime maaneŋ duwaŋ fohebidegoŋ tagiŋ. Unduŋ tubune me muwage foloŋ yawagiŋ adi yadi saŋiniŋhik fodapmaune agaŋ dapmanim hogok nadiŋa ikagiŋ.
Me heki u muwage deti yehitubu-didimeneŋ. Nehinile me ime fafaŋehi naaŋ tububuye yawiiŋ unduŋ madabubuyeŋ tiyaugiŋ.
Adi malabumuŋ gineŋ unduŋ hatiŋila Yahwe kutnimbulabulayeune ne kubugoŋdi nadiyemiŋa momooŋ hinek yehitubu-lodaguk.
Wapumdi yobune sububa wabiune ime giyondaguk u kulemaaŋ fooŋ hakuk.
Kaŋ me heki u imeŋgwaŋ kulemaaŋ fohalune kaŋ nadifo tigiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa Wapumdi yanagilune wooŋ yokwet daŋ une ugiŋneŋ wosuwagiŋ.
Wapum adi weleŋdi hinek yabukahilegukdi yabukahilelak doktiŋa titiŋ momooŋ hinek tiŋa helemahelemaŋ yehitubu-lodalak. Unduŋ doktiŋa adi Yahwe kedem welemomooŋ nadimiŋa niutumbayaneeŋ.
Bepaŋ’walaŋ metamŋiyedut bopneyaneeneŋ wougigit yohautayaneeŋ. Be talitimeŋ hekidut bopneyaneeneŋ undugoŋ, adi lekiŋgoŋhik foloŋ wou nintiloyaneeŋ.
Wapum adi ime wapuhi yehitubu-naŋgadapmaŋ tuguk, kaŋ ime kuyahi kwet gineŋ labiiŋ u maaŋ naŋgadapmaŋ tigiŋ kaŋ kwet silidadapmaguk.
Metamdi kadakaniŋ tubune Wapumdi wendok kibikoŋ kwet galikit u yobune dawaŋ daguk kaŋ kwet uŋoŋ nemek nemu labiiŋ.
Wapum adi kwet simintaneŋ yobune ime fee wodigiŋ unduŋ tubune kwet simintaaŋ u wabiŋa imenit tuguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa metam nanaŋedok map tigiŋ u yahaŋeune yohikwehik uŋgoŋ tiŋa itougiŋ.
Tiŋa nanaŋehik eŋ wainhik diniyeti tubune folooŋ fee mintaune moŋgotnagiŋ.
Wapum adi metamŋiye yehikahaŋneune wapmihi fee minta ulihaka tigiŋ, eŋ makauhik maaŋ undugoŋ minta-ulihaka tigiŋ.
Eŋ memikhiyedi mik gineŋ folofigita yemiŋa yehitiŋafooŋ yehitubu-mekagiŋ.
Unduŋ tubune Wapumdi kibibo memikhiye yahaŋeeŋ kwet fiileŋ yapmeune talik lohi hatigiŋ.
Kaŋ me fiyewakahi hogohi hatigiŋ adi yadi toboniŋ momooŋ hinek yehitubu-lodaguk. Kaŋ wapmihihiyedi dompa bop wendok tuwot minta-ulihakagiŋ.
Metam didimehidi u kaŋ nadifo tiiŋ. Eŋ metam hogohi adi u kaŋ mede-kabe nemu yoiŋ. Mahik galiune hogok kabup hatiiŋ.
Metam nadinadi fuliŋhinit hidi nemenemek hogohogok u nadihinakaneŋ. Tiŋa Yahwe adi weleŋdi hinek nibukahilegukdi nibukahilelak u nadinadiŋila hatineeŋ.
